description_en: Retrieves the performance metrics of an AI container
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-aidb-cluster-performance --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --key PolarDBAIModelCall --start-time 2025-09-17T02:18:00Z --end-time 2025-09-23T01:01:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAIDBClusterPerformance

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息（如集群ID）
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data to retrieve. Valid values: 60 (minutes) and 3600 (hours).

If you set Interval to 60, you can query data from the last month. The maximum time range for a single query is 7 days.
If you set Interval to 3600, you can query data from the last month. The maximum time range for a single query is 7 days
parameters.help_zh:
强制指定获取指定时间粒度的数据，支持60（分钟）、3600（小时）。
Interval=60：最长可查询最近一个月的数据，单次查询的时间跨度最长为7天。
Interval=3600：最长可查询最近一个月的数据，单次查询的时间跨度最长为7天
parameters.name: interval

ApiKey.description_en: The API key for the model service

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the database cluster

DBType.description_en: The type of the database engine. Only polardb_ai is supported
DBType.description_zh: 数据库引擎类型，当前仅支持polardb_ai类型

DBVersion.description_en:
The version number of the database AI engine.

Example: 3.0

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range that was queried. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format and is in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 查询结束时间，查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）

Interval.description_en:
The time granularity of the performance data. Valid values:

60
3600
Interval.description_zh:
性能数据粒度。取值范围如下：

60
3600

PerformanceKeys.description_en: The details of the instance performance parameters

items.description_en: A list of cluster performance data

DBNodeId.description_en: The ID of the cluster node

MetricName.description_en: The name of the specific performance metric
MetricName.description_zh: 具体的性能指标度量名称

Timestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp that indicates when the metric was collected. Unit: milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 监控指标的具体时间点，格式为时间戳，单位为毫秒

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range that was queried. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format and is in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）
